pairs.locus: Aquinas, Summa Theologiae Ia q.46 a.1
pairs.question: Utrum creaturae semper fuerint?
pairs.answer: Nihil praeter Deum ab aeterno fuisse.
pairs.derivation: Author poses the question in running text (Et circa hoc quaeruntur tria. Primo: utrum creaturae semper fuerint) and answers it in the corresponding Respondeo of Articulus 1. Dropped the framing 'Respondeo dicendum' (speech/meta tag) from the answer start; took the operative first sentence 'nihil praeter Deum ab aeterno fuisse', stopping before 'Et hoc quidem ponere non est impossibile' which begins elaboration. Capitalized 'Nihil' and added terminal period; capitalized 'Utrum' and added '?'.

pairs.locus: Aquinas, Summa Theologiae Ia q.46 a.2
pairs.question: Utrum eas incoepisse sit articulus fidei?
pairs.answer: Mundum non semper fuisse, sola fide tenetur, et demonstrative probari non potest.
pairs.derivation: Author poses the question (Secundo: utrum eas incoepisse sit articulus fidei) and answers it in the Respondeo of Articulus 2. Dropped the framing 'Respondeo dicendum quod' from the answer start; took the operative first clause-sentence, stopping before 'sicut et supra de mysterio Trinitatis dictum est' which is a cross-reference aside (the sentence as written continues 'non potest: sicut et supra...'; cut at the first full stop boundary of the answering assertion). Capitalized 'Mundum' and added terminal period; capitalized 'Utrum' and added '?'.
